name: 43701 · Zanesville, OH
findings: ZIP 43701 (Zanesville) has 235 nonprofit organizations. 101 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 86 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43701 (Zanesville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 43701 (Zanesville) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 86 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
